name: New Born — Newborn not enrolled: assign the next female dependent member code
description: Eleven guided steps, one per step of the 092.1 document: check the event hierarchy for PX_092, note the patient's details and the service dates, open Search → Member where the automatic search found nothing, search by the Member ID alone, open the subscriber's row, expand the contract line for the claim's group, check the Members in Contract, assign the next free female newborn member code, validate it and pay the claim.

steps.name: Events resolution tab — check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab and check the events list against the hierarchy of events: any event that comes before PX_092 in the hierarchy must be resolved first. PX_092 (Member code missing or invalid) is the Hard Edit highlighted with an error indication. It means the claim is missing a valid member code, usually for a newborn, and the processor must find or assign the correct one. All Edits lists no other event, so there is nothing to resolve before PX_092 and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The workspace opens with no tab selected, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_092 with a Hard Edit badge, and All Edits lists PX_092 alone.
steps.checklistItem: Check the event hierarchy for PX_092

steps.name: Member information tab — note the patient details
steps.description: Open the Member Info tab and note the patient's details in the Patient section: the name under First Name, Middle Name and Last Name, the date of birth under Date Of Birth (DOB), and the gender under Sex (M = Male, F = Female). This patient was born on 02/12/2026 and is F (Female). Also note the Group Id in the Group Information section: you will match it to a contract line on the Search tab, and leaving the Search tab to look it up resets that search.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', read First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, DOB (02/12/2026) and Sex (F) under Patient, and the Group Id under Group Information.
steps.checklistItem: Note the patient's name, DOB, sex and Group Id

steps.name: Claim Header tab — note the service dates
steps.description: Open the Claim Header tab and note the service dates from the Service from - through field in General Claim Data. The service dates are 02/22/2026 – 02/22/2026. The contract line you pick on the Search tab must cover them.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Header', read Service from - through under General Claim Data: 02/22/2026 - 02/22/2026.

steps.name: Search tab — open the Member sub-tab
steps.description: With the service dates noted, open the Search tab and its Member sub-tab to identify the members on the policy/contract. The system has already searched for the patient automatically: the Member ID, First name, Last name and DOB on the Search Member form are auto-filled. That automatic search found no one, and the results show 'Member/Contract details are not found'.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Member sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Click 'Search', then the 'Member' sub-tab. The Search Member form shows the patient's auto-filled criteria above 'Member/Contract details are not found'.
steps.checklistItem: Open Search → Member and review the automatic search

steps.name: Search by the Member ID only
steps.description: The automatic search came back with no result, so look for the members in the contract manually. Remove the patient's name from the search criteria: clear First name and Last name, and clear the DOB with the Clear DOB (×) button beside it. Do not change or edit the Member ID: it is the member ID on the claim, the same number as the HCID on the Member Info tab. Click Search. Searching by the Member ID alone lists all the members on that ID.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when Search is pressed with the auto-filled Member ID unchanged and First name, Last name and DOB blank. A search that keeps the patient's name, or that finds the members any other way, completes nothing.
steps.hint: Clear First name, Last name and DOB, leave the Member ID exactly as it is, then click Search.
steps.checklistItem: Search the contract by Member ID only

steps.name: Open the subscriber's row
steps.description: The results list the members on the ID. Click the line of the subscriber to open it. Find the subscriber by the Relationship column: the subscriber reads 'SUB - Subscriber' and the spouse reads 'SPS - Spouse'. Opening the subscriber's row lists all the contracts/policies the subscriber is on.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the SUB - Subscriber row is opened. The spouse's row opens without completing anything.
steps.hint: Click the row whose Relationship is 'SUB - Subscriber', or the arrow at its left.

steps.name: Expand the contract line for the claim's group
steps.description: Expand the line that has the same Group number as the Group Id on the Member Info tab, noted in step 2, and whose Effective Date and End Date cover the 02/22/2026 service date. One line carries the same Group # but ended before the service date, and another covers the date under a different Group #; neither is the claim's contract. Expanding the right line shows two buttons: Open Member Detail and Apply Selected Member.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when the line that matches the claim's Group Id and covers the service date is expanded. The other lines expand without completing anything.
steps.hint: Match the Group # column to the Group Id from 'Member Info', check the dates cover 02/22/2026, then click the arrow at the left of that line.
steps.checklistItem: Expand the contract line with the claim's Group Id

steps.name: Open Member Detail and check the Members in Contract
steps.description: Click Open Member Detail on the expanded line. Scroll down to the Members in Contract section: it lists every member on the policy, here member code 10 (SUB - Subscriber) and member code 40 (SPS - Spouse). Check whether the patient on the claim, whose details you noted in step 2, is on that list. She is not listed, so she is a newborn who is not yet enrolled, and a new member code must be given to her.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Open Member Detail is pressed on the line that matches the claim's group. The same button on the other lines opens the same details without completing anything.
steps.hint: In the Member details, scroll to 'Members in Contract' and compare it with the patient's name and DOB from 'Member Info'.
steps.checklistItem: Check the Members in Contract for the patient

steps.name: Member information tab — assign the member code
steps.description: Assign a new member code to the patient from the newborn ranges: a male newborn takes a code from 50 – 69 and a female newborn from 70 – 89. The patient is F (Female), and no member on the contract holds member code 70, since it holds only 10 and 40. The right member code is therefore 70. Return to the Member Info tab and enter 70 in the Member Code field in the Patient section.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on change or blur when Member Code reads 70. A code from the male range, or a later code in the female range, completes nothing.
steps.hint: Female newborn: 70 – 89, and 70 is free. On 'Member Info', type 70 into Member Code under Patient.

steps.name: Validate the member code
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary. The System message under Member Code then confirms the code (Member code: 70 - Female dependent), and the Validation section on the Event Resolution tab shows PX_092 as resolved.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed while Member Code reads 70. Any other code is refused, and the System message asks for the code to be reassigned.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Click it once Member Code reads 70.

steps.name: Submit the Pay decision
steps.description: Once the correct member code is assigned to the patient, pay the claim. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
